subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/898, or close it and land a narrow replacement in openclaw/openclaw?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open conflicting fork PR already owns the GitHub closing path and cannot be edited by maintainers, so automation should not queue another fix until the path is chosen.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and add updated proof.
